integrity: Direct exact polynomial-integral proof and independent rational Gram/kernel checks; originality supported by the cited source comparisons, with publication-priority limitations. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple metric graphs, positive constant edgewise densities, continuous degree-at-most-two elements without derivative matching. The O(1/d) hypercube estimate is not asserted optimal at fixed d; no result for nonconstant edge densities or higher degrees.
title: Sharp universal stability of quadratic projection on finite metric graphs
